d: Bihar ki rajniti se is vakt ki sabse bari aur dilchasp tasvir samne aaee hai. mokama ke purv vidhayak anant sinh ne aarjedi suprimo lalu prasad yadav aur neta pratipaksh tejasvi yadav se mulakat ki hai. tinon netaon ke chehre par tairti muskan ab bihar ke siyasi galiyaron men naee charchaon ko janm de rahi hai. mauka to anant sinh ki chhoti beti shivangi ki shadi (25 navanbar) ka nyauta dene ka tha, lekin jadyu se nishkasan, patni nilam devi se mantri pad ka darja chhinne aur sarkari bangla khali karne ke notis ke bich is mulakat ke behad gahre siyasi mayne nikale ja rahe hain. 2015 ka…
